summary: 周日较安静。Barnabé 的 Ethlabs Week 3 提到正在为 Hegotá 的非主角提案截止日准备更快 slot 的提案：6 秒 slot 未被纳入 Glamsterdam 后，carlbeek 提出 quick slots（EIP-8198），为未来缩短 slot 打基础。ethresear.ch 上有文章分析拍卖式包含列表 AUCIL 的女巫攻击。

items.title: ethresear.ch：AUCIL 的女巫攻击
items.note: 10:28（AbhiMan1601）。包含列表是 PBS 下的抗审查原语，FOCIL 依赖固定的每 slot 参与者且无显式定价，AUCIL 基于拍卖和经济激励。
items.note_en: 10:28 (AbhiMan1601). Inclusion lists are a censorship resistance primitive under PBS; FOCIL relies on fixed per-slot participants with no explicit pricing, while AUCIL is auction-based and relies on economic incentives.

keywords_en: preparing a faster-slot proposal for Hegotá
summary_en: A quiet Sunday. Barnabé's Ethlabs Week 3 said the team is preparing a faster-slot proposal ahead of the Hegotá non-headliner deadline: after 6-second slots were declined for Glamsterdam, carlbeek proposed quick slots (EIP-8198) to prepare the ground for future slot reductions. A post on ethresear.ch analyzed Sybil attacks on AUCIL, an auction-based inclusion list.
